instructions: Preserve Applicant, Publication No, Title and Application No from the WIPO input. They are source data, never generated contact fields.
Enrich Phone No., Email and Agent Name from the explicitly labeled agent, attorney or representative section. Do not substitute applicant or inventor details when agent details are missing.
One output record must use one contact block and one owner. Do not fill missing phone/email/name from another person, applicant, agent, filing or example.
Agent Name is the printed agent person name, or the printed agency name when the form names only an agency. All fields for that owner must have the same block_id and entity.
Country comes from that agent contact block/address. Never use the application prefix, receiving office, inventor country or phone prefix as the contact country.
Classify the selected owner as law_firm, company, individual or unknown only from source evidence. Unknown must not be guessed.
Exclude fax numbers, application/publication/registration numbers, dates, form labels and patent-office contacts.
Read characters from original images, especially 1/l/I, 0/O and rn/m. Never repair an email just because a spelling looks plausible. Mark ambiguous fields illegible.
Missing fields stay blank. If there are multiple different agent blocks and no clear unique contact, retain them in audit evidence for review rather than merge them.
Training examples teach rules only. Never copy their names, emails or phone numbers into another filing.
